intro.title: table layout
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a clean, structured data table to display product information using CSS table layout properties. You will learn how to use display: table, table-row, and table-cell to create table-like structures without HTML table elements. The main technologies involved are CSS display properties and basic styling techniques. This approach gives you more flexibility than traditional HTML tables while maintaining proper alignment and structure. By the end, you'll understand how to create responsive, semantic table layouts using pure CSS.
intro.usecase: Table layout is essential for displaying structured data across countless real-world applications. You'll find it in e-commerce product comparison tables, financial dashboards showing stock portfolios, and admin panels displaying user management data. As a developer, you'll use table layout techniques to create data-rich interfaces like pricing comparison charts, inventory management systems, and analytics reports where information needs clear organization. Mastering table layout ensures you can present complex datasets in a readable, professional format that users can quickly scan and understand.
